In the winter, having warm fruit takes the cold chill away from the quick-and-easy cereal breakfast. It’s
easier than cooking hot cereal, and offers the same warm glow after a chilly morning run.
1 cup 
(100 g) 
Life cereal or Oat Squares
1/2 cup 
(50 g) 
All-Bran or Fiber-One
1/4 cup 
(22 g) 
low-fat granola
1/2 cup 
(75 g) 
blueberries or other fruit
1 cup 
(240 ml) 
low-fat milk
1. In a microwaveable bowl, combine the cereals.
2. Sprinkle with blueberries or other fruit of your choice.
3. Heat in the microwave oven for 20 to 40 seconds, until the blueberries are warm.
4. Pour the cold milk over the top. Dig in!
Yield: 
1 serving
Nutrition Information:
Total calories: 
500
Carbohydrate:
85
Protein: 
20
Fat:
